parameters.help_en: The region of the data migration instance. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued

parameters.help_en: The region of the data migration instance, which is the region of the destination database instance. For more information, see the supported https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the data migration instance. Valid values: small, medium, large, xlarge, and 2xlarge.

For the test performance of each specification, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html.
For instance specifications and pricing, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/117780.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移实例的规格，取值为：small、medium、large、xlarge、2xlarge。

各个规格的测试性能，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html。
实例规格及定价，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/117780.html
parameters.name: migration_job_class

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken参数只支持传入ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
